[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Good Subarrays** [CF 1398C · Good Subarrays](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1398/C){rating="1600"}

"Digit sum $=$ length" is "the average digit is exactly $1$". Subtract $1$ from every digit and the condition becomes **sum $=0$** — and a zero-sum range means two *equal* prefix sums. So the problem is Pattern 2 with $k=0$ on a transformed array, and no substring ever needs to be enumerated.

[Solved in full in @sec-pref-p2-c.]{.card-link}

:::
